scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build && node -e "import('./server/dist/lib/dbEnv.js').then((m) => m.checkDeployEnv())" && npm run db:deploy -w server && npm run db:seed -w server && npm run db:import-legacy -w server -- --if-empty && rm -rf .vercel-static && mkdir .vercel-static && cp -r client/dist .vercel-static/admin && cp -r server/public .vercel-static/assets
